implementation: GPU dynamic graph insertion versus CPU multi-threaded hierarchical insertion
source_sha256_scope: sha256 of canonical JSON source_files_sha256 manifest

method_definitions.ChunkSplice: Existing PyTorch budgeted intra-chunk graph repair.
method_definitions.FAISS-HNSW: Native CPU IndexHNSWFlat.add, or explicitly labeled exact fallback.
method_definitions.cuVS-CAGRA: Native cuVS build/extend/search, or Naive chunk-hole simulator.
method_definitions.MIRAGE: CPU-only multi-layer MIRAGE-ANNS: NN-Descent base and RNG-pruned add; or exact CPU reference.

timing.statistic: median wall milliseconds across independent stream replays
timing.warmup: one complete untimed stream replay using fresh indexes
timing.repeated_updates: each measured replay builds fresh indexes; each batch is added once
timing.includes: adapter validation, allocations, host/device transfers and insertion
timing.excludes: initial build, data/query generation, exact truth and metric computation
timing.cuda_synchronization: PyTorch and native CuPy streams before and after operations
timing.ordering: method order rotated by stage and replay
timing.qps: mixed-cohort batch size divided by median end-to-end query seconds
timing.summary_update_ms: median total update time per replay divided by update count

query_cohorts.angular_normalization: Both corpus and queries are unit normalized; L2 and cosine rankings agree.
query_cohorts.inserted: all inserted vectors/centers so far; new_query_recall10 is this cohort
query_cohorts.latest_chunk: not separately evaluated in external mode
query_cohorts.comparison: all methods share queries and exact truth at each stage

scope: Simulator latency measures this implementation only; it does not estimate external CPU or GPU performance. CPU debug runs do not measure GPU insertion. Native and simulated results must be distinguished.

controls.graph_entries: seeded by active size; old policy uses fixed seeded base entries; native CPU/GPU indexes use their own traversal; exact fallbacks have no graph
